rules.designNote: Do not force long evolution chains. Keep only mechanically natural stages and leave unassigned Taoist skills in standby until their role is clear.
rules.cumulativeBuffBehavior: Taoist buff evolutions do not replace previous buffs. Casting the current buff stage also applies every earlier stage in that same buff chain. This requires ORIGINS-specific implementation rather than Zircon replacement-style evolution.

holy.designNote: Holy attack branch intentionally stops at two stages for now.

dark.designNote: Dark attack branch intentionally stops at two stages for now.

stoneCandidates.EmpoweredHealing: Healing buff/stone that improves Heal or MassHeal instead of being an active evolution stage.

healing.designNote: Healing branch intentionally stops at Heal -> MassHeal. EmpoweredHealing is a modifier stone/buff. SupremeHealing remains in standby.

poison.designNote: Poison branch intentionally uses only PoisonDust -> PoisonCloud. Other poison/debuff mechanics remain unassigned in standby.

stoneCandidates.StrengthOfFaith: Summon-focused buff/stone reserved for the pet branch rather than the general Taoist buff chain.

summon.designNote: Core summon evolution is SummonSkeleton -> SummonJinSkeleton. Shinsu, DemonicCreature, SummonDead and CursedDoll remain separate in standby.

generalBuffs.designNote: Order is provisional from lower/general utility toward stronger/more complete buffs. Stage N casts and applies stages 1 through N; previous buffs remain active and are not replaced.

stealth.designNote: ORIGINS intentionally uses Transparency as the final stealth evolution even though Zircon mechanics differ. The cumulative Taoist buff rule applies.

celestialLight.designNote: CelestialLight remains an independent Taoist skill and is not part of the cumulative general buff or stealth chains.

controlPrison.designNote: ORIGINS treats DarkSoulPrison as the stronger evolution of TrapOctagon: small local trap/control grows into a larger persistent dark prison zone.

stoneCandidates.AugmentResurrection: Modifier stone/buff that improves Resurrection rather than a separate active evolution.

stoneCandidates.AugmentPurification: Modifier stone/buff that improves Purification rather than a separate active evolution.
